# clerk_user (Resource)

Manages (seeds) a Clerk user via the Instance API. Useful for provisioning fixture users in non-production instances and for migration-style seeding with pre-hashed passwords.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Seed a fixture user with a plaintext password.
resource "clerk_user" "seed" {
  email_addresses = ["seed.user@example.com"]
  password        = "ChangeMe-123!"
  first_name      = "Seed"
  last_name       = "User"
  public_metadata = jsonencode({ role = "tester" })
}

# Migration-style seeding with a pre-hashed password.
resource "clerk_user" "migrated" {
  email_addresses      = ["migrated.user@example.com"]
  first_name           = "Migrated"
  last_name            = "User"
  password_digest      = "$2a$10$EpRnTzVlqHNP0.fUbXUwSOyuiXe/QLSUG6xNekdHgTGmrpHEfIoxm"
  password_hasher      = "bcrypt"
  skip_password_checks = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `backup_codes` (List of String, Sensitive) Backup codes to seed for the user. Write-only; never returned by the API.
- `create_organization_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the user is allowed to create organizations.
- `create_organizations_limit` (Number) The maximum number of organizations the user can create.
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp (RFC3339) when the user was created. Set explicitly to backdate a seeded user; backdating forces a new user.
- `delete_self_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the user is allowed to delete their own account.
- `email_addresses` (List of String) Email addresses to associate with the user at creation. The first is treated as primary. Changing this set forces a new user (identifiers are managed via dedicated APIs after creation).
- `external_id` (String) A unique identifier for the user in an external system.
- `first_name` (String) First name of the user.
- `last_name` (String) Last name of the user.
- `legal_accepted_at` (String) Timestamp (RFC3339) when the user accepted legal requirements. Write-only.
- `locale` (String) The user's locale in BCP-47 format.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Plaintext password for the user. Write-only; never returned by the API.
- `password_digest` (String, Sensitive) Pre-hashed password for migration-style seeding. Pair with password_hasher. Write-only.
- `password_hasher` (String) Hashing algorithm used for password_digest (e.g. bcrypt, argon2i, pbkdf2_sha256). Write-only.
- `phone_numbers` (List of String) Phone numbers to associate with the user at creation. Changing this set forces a new user.
- `private_metadata` (String, Sensitive) Private metadata as a JSON string. Only accessible from the backend.
- `public_metadata` (String) Public metadata as a JSON string. Accessible from both the frontend and backend.
- `skip_legal_checks` (Boolean) When true, legal acceptance validation is skipped. Write-only.
- `skip_password_checks` (Boolean) When true, password strength validation is skipped. Write-only.
- `skip_password_requirement` (Boolean) When true, the user can be created without a password. Write-only.
- `totp_secret` (String, Sensitive) TOTP secret to seed for the user. Write-only.
- `unsafe_metadata` (String) Unsafe metadata as a JSON string. Writable from the frontend; do not store sensitive data here.
- `username` (String) Username for the user. Requires usernames to be enabled in the Clerk Dashboard.
- `web3_wallets` (List of String) Web3 wallet addresses to associate with the user at creation. Changing this set forces a new user.

### Read-Only

- `banned` (Boolean) Whether the user is banned.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the user.
- `locked` (Boolean) Whether the user is locked.
- `primary_email_address_id` (String) ID of the user's primary email address.
- `primary_phone_number_id` (String) ID of the user's primary phone number.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp (RFC3339) when the user was last updated.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import clerk_user.seed <user_id>
```
